convention: Reuse prior minimal normal-plane folds and both retained chiral spin lifts; do not choose face signs independently.
face_comparison: K_ijk = U_ik^-1 U_jk U_ij, based at fitting i
tetrahedron: K_ikl K_ijk = K_ijl U_ij^-1 K_jkl U_ij
parallel_matching: s_j = U_ij s_i; fixed spinors around loops are an extra parallel-matching requirement, not the definition of higher coherence
predictions: All properly based tetrahedral cells fill. Triangular holonomy is nontrivial with no fixed spinor under the existing parallel matching. Connected trees retain a doublet. Naively omitting the base transport can create a spurious tetrahedral defect.
source_corruption_control: Independently flip one derived face comparison by -I; this violates its edge-derived definition and creates a rank-two tetrahedral defect. It is a changed source, not a gauge repair.
scope: Existing source-derived five-cell spin geometry only; not identification with the native single-cell 144 protocol or a P/N/E molecular law.
